request.deadline: 12 months; new grant period begins after closure of the existing contract
deliverables: Essential maintenance of the codebase including dependency updates, Cardano protocol compatibility, performance improvements, bug fixing, and documentation
Community support including issue triage, review of external contributions, enhancements driven by ecosystem feedback, and public communication
AI-friendly documentation and integration resources for AI-driven development workflows
Administration and oversight through Intersect budget administration fee
request.recipient: 2026 Treasury Reserve Smart Contract stake address stake1784sdxt6jjennmstphgdu7l7c2scf5d02a6cve2dgn5s2kq5u3j9v, submitted by Intersect on behalf of TxPipe as vendor
request.what: Fund Dolos by TxPipe: maintaining Cardano's Lightweight Data Node, Year 2, including part-time maintenance over 12 months, community support, and AI-friendly documentation/integration resources.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 540,750 ADA total, consisting of 525,000 ADA for Dolos maintenance and enhancement plus a 15,750 ADA Intersect budget administration fee.
The motivation text states the maintainer funding is 420,000 ADA plus a 105,000 ADA contingency reserve for a part-time maintainer over 12 months at an annual rate of $105,000 USD.
Dolos is described as a lightweight Cardano data node built in Rust that provides resource-efficient access to chain data without running a full node.

Dolos is claimed to connect directly to the Cardano network, index ledger primitives, and expose interfaces including Mini-Blockfrost, UTxO-RPC, Mini-Kupo, and an Ouroboros N2C Unix socket compatible with Cardano-cli and Ogmios.
The document states Dolos has 939 commits, 80 releases, 129 stars, 51 forks, and 27 contributors, and links to the Dolos GitHub repository.
The proposal says Dolos aligns with Intersect Strategic Pillar 2 focus area A.3 for Developer Experience and open-source incentives.

The document states the proposal achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase and provides references to voting documentation and final audited results.
The document asserts the requested amount did not, at submission, breach the applicable 350M ADA Net Change Limit for Epoch 613 to Epoch 713.
The document states TxPipe has received funding through 30 Project Catalyst proposals from Funds 9 through 14, with 26 successfully delivered and 4 under development and on schedule.

The proposal describes oversight through Intersect, milestone-based disbursement controls, smart contracts developed by Sundae Labs, named oversight entities, and a dashboard for community audit and on-chain verification.

summary: The anchor requests 540,750 ADA through Intersect for a 12-month continuation of Dolos maintenance by TxPipe, with claims centered on open-source infrastructure value, prior ecosystem use, Intersect budget-process approval, NCL compliance, and smart-contract-based fund administration.
